chapter.verse: A tawpna ah sanggamte aw, Topa' sungah lungdam un. Hih thute mah kong gelhkik pen nawngkai ka sa kei a, note' adingin zong bitna ahi hi.
Uite kidawmin peel un. Thusia bawlte kidawmin peel un. Tungtham vun-at mite kidawmin peel un.
A hang pen vun-at mi cihte ei i hizaw a, Pasian' Kha tawh a biate, Khris Jesu sungah a kipakte i hih manin eite' lungmuanna pen cilesa sung hilo hi.
Keimahmah zong cilesa sungah lungmuan nading thu ka neih hangin ka tuaci kei hi. Mi khatpeuh cilesa sungah lungmuan nading thu nei a kisak leh ke'n ka tam neihzaw hi.
Ni giat cinni-in vun-atna ka sang hi. Israel minam sungpan Benjamin beh, Hebrew mite' sungpana piang Hebrew mi khat ka hi a, thukhun lamsang ah Pharisee mi ka hi hi.
Thalawpna lamsang ah pawlpi ka bawlsia a, thukhun' sunga dikna thu lamsang ah ka paubaang kei hi.
Himah taleh hih hamphatna kici khempeuh Khris' hangin supna bangin ka ngaihsun hi.

Bek thamlo, Khris Jesu ka Topa ka theihna mah manphazaw tham ahih manin na khempeuh supna bangin ka ngaihsun hi. Ama' adingin na khempeuh ka suplawh khinzo a, Khris ka ngahlawh nadingin tuate ninbulom bangin ka ngaihsun hi.
Ama' sunga ka om theih pen zong thukhun pana hong pai diktatna thu ka ngah man hilo-in Khris ii ciamkipna tungtawna hong pai, upna tunga kinga, Pasian' kiangpana diksakna thu hang hizaw hi.
Tua pen Khris leh ama' thawhkik vangliatna ka theih ka tel nading, ama' gimthuakna thuakpihin ama' sihna thu ah amah tawh ka kibat nading, leh
lam khat teitei tawh misite' lakpan thawhkikna ka ngah theih nading ahi hi.
Tua ka cih ciangin ke'n ngah khinzo, ka tangtut khinzo, a ci ka hikei a, Khris Jesu in kei hong mankip khin ahih mah bangin kei zong tua thu a mankip dingin a delh ka hizaw hi.
Sanggamte aw, tua thu a mankip khinzo-in ka kingaihsun kei a, ka hih khat ahihleh nunglama omte mangngilhbawlin mailama omte a hahbawl ka hizaw hi.
Khris Jesu' sunga om, tunglam pana Pasian' sapkhiatna tawh kipawl gualzawhman ngah nadingin kung zuanin ka delh hi.
Tua hi a, ei a picing mite in hih bang ngaihsutna nam nei ni. Tua lo a dang khatpeuh a ngaihsun na om uhleh tua zong Pasian in note' kiangah hong pholak ding hi.
Bangbang hileh i ngah khitsa thute tawh kituakin gamta ni.
Sanggamte aw, kei hong ettehte na pawm unla ko' sunga na muh uh etsakna lim tawh kituakin a nungta mite na en gige un.
A hang pen tamveipi kong gen ngei thu, tu-in zong khitui tawh kong genin ah mi tampitak Khris' singlamteh galbawlin nungta gamta uh hi.
Amaute' lamtawp pen kisiatna hi a, amaute' pasian pen a gilpi uh ahi hi. Leitung nate lunggulh uh a, maizumhuai thute ah kipak uh hi.
Eite i hihleh i inntekna mun pen vantung hi a, tua dinmun panin Honpa khat, Topa Jesu Khris, lawptak i ngak hi.
Tua Topa in na khempeuh ama' khutnuai ah koihna-in a zat, a gamtang vangliatna mah tawh a ginalo i pumpi pen vangtaang ama' pumpi a sun dingin hong khelsak ding hi.
